_about: Which verified schedule rows apply to each prototype, per agency, and how. calc_per_unit.py reads this with prototypes.json. Methods: per_unit = rate; per_sq_ft = rate x unit_sq_ft; meter_each_unit = rate for one meter per unit; meter_shared = rate / units_on_site; lower_bound = computed but the true charge can be higher (total marked incomplete). own_programs_missing: the agency charges a program whose schedule we lack, so every total is incomplete.
